statement: Juan's teaching centers on laboratory work in high-frequency technology, radiofrequency subsystems, and linear network analysis. Across undergraduate and master's courses at UC3M, he connects circuit and electromagnetic concepts with the instruments, workflows, and practical constraints used in RF engineering. His mentoring experience includes co-tutoring a bachelor's thesis on SiGe antenna design for vehicular radar. Students may contact him about possible bachelor's or master's thesis topics related to his research; opportunities depend on current availability and UC3M arrangements.

supervision.title: Antenna design in SiGe technology for vehicular radar in present and future frequency bands
